Spinach is mainly water, which is why when you cook it down too much, it becomes a wet slimy, chewy green blob. Also, overcooking veggies removes a lot of the nutrient value of them. Spinach, since it is mostly water has little cell wall structure (unlike red chard for example, more structure, so cook longer especially the stem).
